results.title: A Little Dream of Me
results.original_title: Cảm Ơn Người Đã Thức Cùng Tôi
results.overview: Cảm Ơn Người Đã Thức Cùng Tôi is an emotional journey of young people searching for answers to the question, “What is your dream?”—only to discover, as they step into adulthood, that the most important question becomes, “Who do you want to pursue that dream with?”

results.title: Tikus!
results.overview: A group of people are marooned at an isolated wellness retreat because of floods. One by one each of them gets killed as it's slowly revealed there is a murderer among them.

results.title: Alterity
results.overview: Looks back onto the arrival of home computers like the Atari ST and Commodore, that brought the creative process into people’s homes. Films and music originated outside of the traditional studio system, without cameras or musical instruments, but through generative software.

results.title: Echo Chamber
results.overview: An exploration in narcissistic desire, a kind of autoeroticopsis in being the subject of desire for yourself.

results.title: Littermates
results.overview: Amidst the chaos of a mysterious war, two victims of an attack take refuge at a cottage in the English countryside, where an enigmatic caretaker insists they cannot leave.

results.title: Mother Tongue
results.overview: When a spirited ten-year-old boy is mocked in class for calling "sign language" his mother tongue, he must rediscover pride in his identity, with the quiet support of his grandmother and the love that language can hold beyond words.

results.title: Mog's Bad Thing
results.overview: Follows Mog, a tabby cat, who does a bad thing during a cat show hosted by her family in their garden, hides in the attic feeling sorry for herself, and must find a way to save the day.

results.title: Killer Curve
results.overview: After her brother is murdered, Jade Carter uncovers a secret list linking powerful elites to a deadly conspiracy. As corrupt forces close in, she must outsmart both criminals and law enforcement to expose the truth - and survive long enough to get revenge.

results.title: NJPW Road to Destruction 2026 - Day 6
results.overview: The sixth night of Road to Destruction 2026 took place on September 16, 2026, at Tomakomai City Gymnasium in Tomakomai, Hokkaido, Japan.

results.title: NXT Stand & Deliver 2026
results.overview: Stand & Deliver 2026 was a professional wrestling event produced by World Wrestling Entertainment (WWE) for its NXT brand, held on April 4, 2026, at The Factory at The District in St. Louis, Missouri, marking the first edition to take place outside of WrestleMania week and NXT’s first standalone event to stream on YouTube in the United States. It was headlined by Joe Hendry (c) vs. Ethan Page vs. Ricky Saints vs. Tony D’Angelo in a Fatal Four Way match for the NXT Championship.

results.title: looksMAXXING
results.overview: When a dopamine-depleted young man joins an online forum promising a better life through physical perfection, he descends on a destructive path.

results.title: Native Sin
results.overview: A Native American priest and his medicine woman sister must set aside old resentments to unite faith and tradition against a vengeful spirit.

results.title: Reflections
results.overview: A group of youths discuss their experiences with mental health in an interview setting, looking at their childhood, education, family and friends.

results.title: Black Sunflowers
results.overview: Black Sunflowers is a mosaic of Ukrainian youth, shuttling between the frontlines and civilian life, captured by the gifted American filmmaker James Marcus Haney (No Cameras Allowed) collaborating with an esteemed Ukrainian crew.

results.title: Decision 2026: Battle for Control of Congress
results.original_title: Decision 2026: Battle for Control of Congress
results.overview: With less than a month to the 2026 midterm elections, in this NBC News special report, Kristen Welker, Hallie Jackson, and Steve Kornacki examine what's at stake for both parties as they battle for control of Congress and what polling says across the United States.

results.title: ZombieSluts Stripclub Slaughterhouse
results.overview: A zombie outbreak happens at local strip club. Patrons and dancers attempt to survive.

results.title: When Things Move
results.overview: During moving day, Joaquina and her cousin Leonor turn the chaos of boxes into an adventure. Between games, jealousy, and discoveries, the girls explore the corners of a house that seems to hold a secret of its own.
